paragraphs: Onward deploys transportation ordering and management software, builds networks of transportation partners, and operates Companion Rides, an assisted ride share service. Companion Rides are presented on the site as a door-through-door assisted rideshare solution. The ordering tool is offered as one place to order, track and manage healthcare transportation.

Trip status alerts tell teams when a ride is ready or has safely arrived. The site names senior living communities, PACE programs and hospitals as the groups this transportation solution is built for. Transit agencies are named separately as a market for on-demand transportation solutions. Buyers can add their own transport partners or choose from partners the company has vetted.

quote.text: Order any type of healthcare transportation online from one place
